name: anyweb
description: Run bounded local website tasks, check repair claims, and optionally manage hosted continuity without exposing saved secrets.

interface.shortDescription: Run bounded local tasks and check repairs.
interface.longDescription: Use the anyweb plugin to run supported website tasks in visible local Chrome, retrieve repair outcomes, manage explicitly approved hosted continuity, and Tell Jacky. It is not a general-purpose automation tool.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my AnyWeb repair is ready.
Continue a supported website draft on this computer.
Set up optional hosted continuity for my website account.
Tell Jacky about an AnyWeb problem.
